reviewer: Independent AI reviewer (Claude Sonnet), fresh context, separate from the author; did not see the author's reasoning.

meaning_first.independence_note: Blind findings per item were written to content/reviews/090-review.md from the source-only packet of the original (hash 7d872994804f81f20c5dbc481ed1a10a00fc39095fada1d40e8603a449208368) before questions, notes or the plan assignment were opened. After repairs the packet was rebuilt from the proposed bytes and the meaning pass repeated for the changed scripts (adres-wijzigen, school-ziek-kind, afvalpas-uitleg, ziekenhuis-parkeren).

tone_balance.scope_note: All 12 sources are ordinary everyday scenes. The author labelled buren-keuken lightly humorous because of the neighbour's remark about waking at six; the reviewer sees ordinary warmth, not a joke. The batch contributes 0 lightly funny tasks (cap ceil(12 x 0.15) = 2); the plan allows about one in eight, so the coordinator should check the combined A2 count.

batch_check.result: Checked 12 items, 28 questions. No failures; 8 vocabulary warnings judged (see vocabulary).

checks.vocabulary: Compounds judged transparent for A2: keukenbedrijf, hoofdpijn, lesauto, museumwinkel, busstation, grasveld, binnenlopen, zwemplas (with 'Zwemt u graag buiten?' and 'Zwemmen is gratis'). badmeester is half transparent but explained by 'let een badmeester op de zwemmers' and appears in no prompt or option; kept. garderobe is the one allowed unlisted word, explained twice, and q3 avoids it. knieën is explained by 'zoals een kat'. Listed words remain hard in context: patiënten (item 10) is acceptable because the news item repeats 'bezoekers'.
checks.key_balance: A 8, B 8, C 9, D 3 of 28 (D exists only in six four-option questions); no key letter three times in a row; no key is the longest option after the edits to uitnodiging q2 and bus q2.
checks.voices: Two different roles in each dialogue (f-adult+m-young, m-casual+f-older, m-adult+f-young); no m-adult with f-adult. Monologues: f-adult, m-older, narrator x2, f-mature, m-adult, presenter x2, f-young; gender fits the drawn person (male physio m-adult).
checks.names: Web search on 5 Nov 2026 for 'Hotel De Groene Kade' and 'Kapper Kort en Krul' found no business with these names (nearest: De Groene Afslag, De Kade Groningen). Each recurring name appears in at most two items.
checks.realism: Gemeente item: the clerk states a requirement for this visit ('nu niet'), no deadline or legal claim. Calendar checked: 9 and 14 November 2026 are Monday and Saturday; 12 June 2027 is a Saturday.
